layman_headline: The market is fearful and every swing candidate looks weak — now is the time to wait, not chase.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is sitting in 'Fear' territory at 27/100 and has been worsening over the past week. Bitcoin is down about 2.3% over seven days. Of the seven coins our system flagged as potential trades, nearly all are in confirmed downtrends with bearish chart structures. The one coin showing momentum (KAITO) has an RSI of 87 — extremely overbought — meaning it's already run too far too fast to be a safe entry. There is no compelling setup with both a strong technical foundation and a clear catalyst right now.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. None of the current setups offer a good risk-to-reward ratio. Let the market find a bottom or show a clear reversal signal before committing money.

KAITO (RSI 87, +87% 5-day momentum) is dangerously overbought — our validated signal intelligence shows RSI is the most reliable indicator at 71% win rate, and it screams 'don't buy' here. FET, ENA, MON, DASH, and LDO are all below all major moving averages with bearish chart biases ranging from -0.70 to -1.70. The Fear & Greed Index at 27 is just above our validated rule threshold of 25 for 'Extreme Fear' — at 60% reliability this indicator suggests ambiguity, not opportunity. With Bitcoin ETFs bleeding $265M and a major cold-wallet exploit spreading, macro headwinds reinforce caution.
